messages:
sarah: FYI ACME reported tool invocation failures after last prompt tweak. Root cause looks like schema mismatch caused by our few-shot examples changing arg shape. Posting logs.

sarah: error from /v1/tool/invoke -> 400 SchemaValidationError: 'postal_address' required but got 'address'. request_id=req_9b3f

sarah: repro payload (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/tool/invoke
{
  "tool": "shipping_lookup",
  "args": {
    "address": "123 Market St",
    "zip": "94105"
  }
}
```

mike: :eyes: when was the last prompt change? any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: deployed redwood-services@v2.14.1 by ci-bot at 1802345600

raj: likely cause: few-shot examples in system prompt used "address" field in examples; runtime maps arg names from model call. Model learned to emit 'address' instead of 'postal_address'.

olivia: customer says it worked before, started ~10m after deploy. They hit it in production and see repeated 400s.

mike: can we hotfix by normalizing keys server-side? e.g. accept both "address" and "postal_address" and coerce.

raj: yes, quick patch possible. Also add stricter schema validation in model->tool bridge. I can ship a normalization shim.

sarah: would prefer to also roll back the prompt change if that's easier. Who owns the prompt doc?

mike: that was changed by docsux last night for few-shot clarity. tagging them to revert. @docsux can you revert to previous examples?

olivia: in meantime, can we provide customer workaround? maybe set strict_schema=false on their account to accept flexible args.

raj: runtime supports "schema_mode": "lenient" toggle. I can enable for acct ACME temporarily. Will patch normalization within 30m.

sarah: please also capture repro steps for CS playbook.

mike: repro steps: 1) set account schema_mode=strict; 2) send example payload above; 3) observe 400 and req id. I'll add to the ticket.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/432 — adds shim + tests. Will monitor metrics.

olivia: pinging customer that we're enabling lenient mode and working on patch. :thumbsup:

sarah: thanks team. action items: raj patch + enable lenient, mike write repro + update ticket, docsux revert prompt. update in 30.
